description: This file implements a low-level printf() function for formatted output, including internal helper functions for formatting characters, strings, and numbers. It utilizes macros, static variables, and function pointers, and relies on an external board_putc() function for output. The code provides custom formatting capabilities without standard library functions.

methods.name: void lp_Print(void (* output)(void *,char *,int),void * arg,char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: Performs formatted printing by parsing the format string and handling variadic arguments, supporting different data types and width/precision modifiers.

methods.name: int PrintChar(char * buf,char c,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Formats a single character into the buffer with optional alignment.

methods.name: int PrintString(char * buf,char * s,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Formats a string with specified width and alignment into the buffer.

methods.name: int PrintNum(char * buf,unsigned long u,int base,int negFlag,int length,int ladjust,char padc,int upcase)
methods.description: Converts a number into a string with given base, handling negative values, padding, and case.

methods.name: void printf_output(void * arg,char * s,int l)
methods.description: Callback function used by printf to output characters via board_putc, including handling newline characters.

methods.name: void printf(char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Public function exposing formatted output functionality similar to standard printf.
